verdict.rationale: The evidence pack includes only the title of a 'Payment Module' documentation page. Nothing in the pack shows that a merchant can choose among third-party payment gateways or charge in multiple currencies. The axis clearly applies to a commerce platform, so the lack of evidence makes this 'none' rather than 'na'.

support.subject: As a merchant, I can choose among third-party payment gateways and charge in multiple currencies when the built-in option doesn't fit
